eps.ov: Lin Ling finds himself filling the role of superhero Nice when he witnesses the unthinkable.
eps.oa: «لين لينغ» يجد نفسه يؤدي دور البطل الخارق «نايس» حين يشهد ما لا يخطر على بال.

eps.ov: Nice and Moon work together to live up to fans' expectations while devising a plan to regain their freedom.
eps.oa: يعمل «نايس» و«مون» معاً ليكونا عند ظن المعجبين، وهما يدبّران خطة لاستعادة حريتهما.

eps.ov: Nice (Lin Ling) aims to defeat the Ever-Standing Hero in order to rank up into the top ten.
Nice (Lin Ling) faces off with God Eye to save Moon.
Yang Cheng, an E-Soul stage actor, struggles with gaining popularity while juggling work and romance.
Yang Cheng gains public trust after footage of him saving Pomelo makes its way around social media.
Yang Cheng seeks revenge for what happened to Shang Chao.
A girl who is luckier than usual survives a plane crash and is taken to an orphanage.
After escaping the orphanage, Cyan is forced to fend for herself until she's presented with an opportunity.
After Cyan's departure, both the orphanage and its surroundings are plunged into bad luck.
The young Liu Yuwei enters the top 10 rankings as the hero Queen and is on her way to becoming a top hero.
Queen loses to an anonymous man in the hero tournament. The public begins to associate misfortune with Lucky.
Genius youth inventor Loli dreams of becoming a hero, but her looks prevent her from gaining Trust Value.
Loli and Nuonuo face previous top hero DJ Shindig who launched an assault on the Glimmer Laboratory.
Ghostblade reflects on what led him to become a hero, and vows to fill a role he wasn't able to before.
Ghostblade uses the mission to get closer to Nuonuo, but danger lurks just around the corner.
Little Johnny's past and his father's ties to other heroes is revealed.
Little Johnny becomes a young hero to find out the truth surrounding his father's death.
The exploration team prepares to enter the alien ship, but they are not the only ones.
Inside the spaceship there is a showdown between different camps.
Nice tries to keep his smile and Dragon Boy begins his mission.
Nice appears in the middle of Smile and Dragon's fight. But is he friend or foe?
Ahu grew up in the circus and doesn't like children, but everything changes when he meets Xin Ya.
The heroes go after X, Ahu discovers the truth and the tournament is about to begin.
